description: feat(worker): the base is a manifold union with the figure (board-9 two-shell concat only as the logged fallback for a non-manifold figure), an auto diameter that keeps the text outside the footprint, BASE_TEXT_UNSUPPORTED_CHARS for glyphs the font lacks, and a centered original/
notes:
WHY: a printable miniature is ONE body. Board 9 put the figure and the disc into one .drc as two overlapping closed shells (the figure sinks BASE_SINK_MM into the disc); board 10 unions them with manifold-3d, which the worker already loads for the disc. The probe (board header above) proved the three mesh paths (manifold figure, non-manifold figure, STL-like duplicated vertices) and found that the board-9 text placement puts the text INSIDE the footprint, where the union swallows it - hence the text band in the auto diameter.
